clue.text: Involved in a tussle with fine Scots fish

parts.note: braw is the Scots word for fine or handsome
ling is a cod-like sea fish

explanation.surface: Someone wrestling with a good Scottish fish that won't come quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: Brawling means fighting noisily, the activity of a scuffle or scrap.

clue.text: Island cuts trouble in the interior

indicators.note: trouble goes inside the cuts, in their interior

parts.note: barbs are cutting remarks
ado means fuss or bother

explanation.surface: An island where cuts bring trouble inland.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbados is a Caribbean island nation.

clue.text: Notice how one enunciates "habit'

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
diction is the manner of pronouncing words

explanation.surface: Pointing out how someone pronounces the word habit.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit, in the sense of a drug habit, is a dependency.

clue.text: Another place where cricket is played

explanation.surface: Another venue where cricket is played.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another place' is the Commons' traditional way of referring to the upper House in Parliament; Lord's in London is the home of cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: MPs call the House of Peers 'another place', and the London cricket ground of the MCC shares its name.

clue.text: Stew brings battle to a premature conclusion

indicators.note: the battle is stopped before its last letter is reached

parts.note: Navarino was an 1827 naval battle in the Greek War of Independence

explanation.surface: A stew that cut short a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Navarin is a French lamb or mutton casserole with vegetables.

clue.text: A short time in incredible servitude

indicators.note: the clue says the short time goes in the word for incredible, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: tall, as in a tall story, means hard to believe
hr is the abbreviation for hour

explanation.surface: A brief but unbelievable spell of being enslaved.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrall is bondage, the state of being in someone's power.

clue.text: Footballer encountering snag in a tie

parts.note: a half, such as a halfback, is a football player position
a hitch is a snag or problem

explanation.surface: A footballer hits a snag in a drawn match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tie' suggests a drawn game but is a knot.
explanation.definitionFit: A half hitch is a simple knot used to fasten a rope.

clue.text: Bug turning up say in ribonucleic acid

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reads the whole assembly from bottom to top
the word for say goes inside ribonucleic acid

parts.note: RNA is the abbreviation for ribonucleic acid
eg, for example, means say

explanation.surface: An insect turning up in a sample of RNA.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bug' looks like an insect but is a verb, to annoy. REGNA read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To bug someone is to annoy or irritate them, to rile.

clue.text: Settled on some petitions

parts.note: lit means settled or landed, as a bird does
any means some

explanation.surface: Agreed on certain requests.
explanation.definitionFit: A litany is a series of prayers or supplications, and by extension a list of requests.

clue.text: Fun for fool since others left

indicators.note: every other letter is struck out and those left form the answer

explanation.surface: A fool having fun since everyone else went home.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the 1st, 3rd, 5th... letters of 'for fool since' gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A frolic is playful merriment or a spree.

clue.text: Revere, for instance, a jury's addition to verdict

explanation.surface: Paul Revere somehow tacked onto a jury's verdict.
explanation.walkthrough: Paul Revere is famous for his midnight ride in 1775 warning of the British approach; a jury may append a recommendation to its verdict.
explanation.definitionFit: Revere was a horseman on a famous ride, and a codicil appended to a verdict, such as a plea for mercy, is called by the same name.

clue.text: Flimsy flare

explanation.surface: A flimsy flare, two words describing a weak signal rocket.
explanation.definitionFit: Featherweight things are flimsy, and a coloured signal flare fired from a pistol has the same two-word name.

clue.text: Eccentric ran castle inherited from forebears

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: An oddball who ran a castle that came down the family line.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral describes what belongs to one's lineage, passed down through generations.

clue.text: Soldiers go head first into German lake

indicators.note: the soldiers are said to go into the German, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: Hun is an old derogatory term for a German

indicators.note: the last letter of the soldiers' abbreviation goes to the front, heading the pair

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops dive headlong into a lake in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German' reads as an adjective with lake, but Hun is an old wartime nickname for a German. Huron is one of North America's Great Lakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Huron is one of the Great Lakes, between Michigan and Ontario.

clue.text: Old measure for old letter

parts.note: a micron is a millionth of a metre, a unit of length

explanation.surface: Swapping an old unit of measurement for an old letter.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'old' is padding for the surface: omicron is a Greek letter still in use.
explanation.definitionFit: Omicron is the fifteenth letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Forgiveness of sin is more liberal

indicators.note: liberal means free and loose, so the letters are freely rearranged

explanation.surface: Being pardoned for sin is a more liberal approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Remission of sins is the pardon or cancellation of them.

clue.text: Swell copper at first prevented from travelling

indicators.note: copper is placed at the front of the charade, before the swell

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a swell or toff is a smartly dressed upper-class person

explanation.surface: A smart policeman stopped from going anywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' reads as a policeman but is the element; 'Swell' is the British slang noun for a posh person.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolated people, say by floods or snow, are said to be stranded with no way out.

clue.text: Data not in an arrangement

indicators.note: not here means without, so the letters of in are removed

parts.note: information is data
taken as written

explanation.surface: Data that is not in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A formation is a structured layout, as of troops or aircraft.

clue.text: Predict toll-free travelling

indicators.note: travelling means moving about, so the letters are shifted around

explanation.surface: Forecasting free road travel without tolls.
explanation.definitionFit: To foretell is to prophesy or forecast.

clue.text: Sloth, for example, is sensual

explanation.surface: Laziness as a deadly sin described as sensual.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloth is a mammal, a creature of the wild; and carnal, physical appetites are called by the same adjective.

clue.text: Generous? Mean, when deprived of opening

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is taken away

parts.note: slavish means servile or base, in the sense of mean and abject

explanation.surface: Is someone generous or mean when denied an opportunity?
explanation.definitionFit: Lavish means profuse and open-handed with money.

clue.text: Movement in school brought to zero, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of the next word may be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A school campaign that achieved nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Movement' suggests a campaign but is a section of a symphony; ERZO is the anagram of ZERO.
explanation.definitionFit: A scherzo is a lively section of a symphony or sonata, one of its parts.

clue.text: Genuine soldiers in ceremonial clothes

indicators.note: clothes is a verb, the outer words dressing the letters held inside them

explanation.surface: Real troops in full dress uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincere means honest and without pretence.

clue.text: Impede the selection of food and drink

definitions.text: the selection of food and drink

explanation.surface: Something gets in the way of the picnic.
explanation.definitionFit: To obstruct is to impede, and a wicker basket of provisions given as a gift shares the name.

clue.text: Maps produced by a retired sailor

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the word for sailor is read backwards

parts.note: an old salt is a seasoned sailor

explanation.surface: Charts drawn up by an old seaman now ashore.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a bound collection of charts of the world.

clue.text: Ring up about one to get Violet

indicators.note: the ring goes about the one, around it
in a down clue up means the assembly is read from the bottom

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Phoning around to reach a woman called Violet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Violet' looks like a name but is the colour; CAILL read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilac is a pale purple shade of violet.

clue.text: See mark — it's clear

parts.note: v stands for vide, Latin for see, used in references
to mark something is to point it out or show it

explanation.surface: Look at this sign: everything is obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear someone is to show they were blameless, to justify them.

clue.text: Bar became popular early on

indicators.note: popular is placed early, in front of became

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
got means became, as in got angry

explanation.surface: A bar that grew popular in its early days.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingot is a cast block of metal such as gold.

clue.text: Bedding provided by noisy, amiable fool

indicators.note: noisy says the words are heard spoken rather than read as spelt

parts.note: pally means friendly and an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A loud but friendly idiot provides the bedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A palliasse is a straw-filled mattress.

clue.text: Beef beginning to get ready for eating

indicators.note: beginning to takes the first letter of the next word

parts.note: ripe fruit is ready to eat

explanation.surface: Beef just starting to be ready to cook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beef' looks like meat but is slang for a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are informal for a complaint or grumble.

clue.text: Late payment made for accommodation outside the city

indicators.note: the payment is placed outside the city, wrapping around it

parts.note: rent is what a tenant pays for a home
EC is the postcode area of the City of London

explanation.surface: Rent paid late for a home out in the suburbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Late in the sense of lately, not long ago, as in a newly past event.

clue.text: Watch cuckoo line nest

indicators.note: cuckoo means crazy, so the following letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Keep an eye out for a cuckoo laying in a nest.
explanation.definitionFit: A watch is a guard on duty, as is a sentry posted on lookout.
